parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by a ‘button phobia’.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe cognitive-behavioural therapy (CBT) as a treatment for a button phobia.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain one strength and one weakness of cognitive-behavioural therapy (CBT) as a
treatment for anxiety disorders.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe explanations of depression.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate explanations of depression, including a discussion of nature versus nurture. 
Psychology and consumer behaviour

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by a ‘model of communication’ with reference to advertising.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe McCarthy’s ‘4 Ps marketing mix’ model of advertising.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain one similarity and one difference between McCarthy’s 4 Ps marketing mix model of
advertising and Lauterborn’s 4 Cs marketing mix model of advertising.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe what psychologists have discovered about sound and consumer behaviour.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about sound and consumer behaviour,
including a discussion on ecological validity. 
Psychology and health

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Explain what is meant by ‘stimulation therapy/TENS’ in the management and treatment of
pain.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe one way of measuring pain.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Discuss the validity of the measure of pain that you described in part (b).

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe what psychologists have discovered about the misuse of health services.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about the misuse of health services, including
a discussion about generalisability. 
Psychology and organisations

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by ‘groupthink’.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe strategies to avoid groupthink.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Discuss the applications of these strategies to everyday life in organisations.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about health and safety in the working
environment.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about health and safety in the working
environment, including a discussion about qualitative and quantitative data.
